non_deterministic_rules.GENERATE_PRE_SAVE_SUMMARY: Summary prose is produced by the LM; the numeric data it summarizes is covered by EstimationCalculator/MonthDistributor.
non_deterministic_rules.SELECT_INDUCTOR_CRAN:semantic-ranking: Free-text best-fit ranking from arbitrary natural language is LM-only. The deterministic refactor covers keyword/substring selection + documented full-standard fallback, not semantic ranking.
non_deterministic_rules.VALIDATE_LINE_SELECTION:explanation: incompatibility_reason prose is LM-only; the is_compatible DECISION is covered via are_lines_compatible (BR-06/BR-07).
